details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) A pipeline workflow phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, validate, orchestrate) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Documentation (README.md, docs/, agents.md fragments)
C) Helper scripts or tests under scripts/ or tests/
D) Something else (please name the file, workflow or feature)
Q2: What problem should be fixed, or what should improve?
Choices:
A) A specific bug or failing behaviour (please describe it, ideally with a run link or log excerpt) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Performance or cost (for example, fewer Actions runs, fewer tokens or fewer API calls)
C) Reliability or self-healing of an existing workflow
D) Usability or clarity of the docs or prompts
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A concrete acceptance criterion you will state (for example, "workflow X no longer fails with Y") (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable target (for example, a percentage reduction in runs, time or cost)
C) The behaviour is covered by a new or updated contract test
